# ClipTavera
> ClipTavera (cliptavera.com) is a content-repurposing studio operated by Apex Grid Engineering PLLC. It turns long-form recordings a customer owns — podcasts, interviews, webinars, talks, lessons — into short-form clip drafts, hooks and captions that the customer reviews and approves before any use.

## Key facts
- Customer-owned media only: every source requires a completed rights attestation before processing; ClipTavera never scrapes or rips third-party content.
- Deliverable is drafts for customer review. Nothing is published or posted automatically.
- Every hook and quote traces to the source at a stated timecode; misattributed or distorted drafts are corrected as marked new versions.
- Customer media is never used to train models and never used in marketing without specific written permission.
- Test pricing (prelaunch, payments not yet open): Starter $49/mo, Studio $99/mo, Team $199/mo.
- Contact: info@cliptavera.com

## Founder
Jeremy "Chico" Mills — Founder & CEO. Serial entrepreneur · USAF veteran. Jeremy Mills is the founder and owner of 10+ companies, led by Apex Grid Engineering. ClipTavera is an Apex Grid Engineering PLLC company.
